mode: Behavioral scenarios; expected outcomes are rubrics, not executed MCP results

evals.prompt: Instagram login/approval succeeds but returns to the Connect page.
evals.expected_output: The skill traces callback/state/token/account/subscription layers, distinguishes Meta permission/review issues from SHVYA callback failures, and does not assume consent means connected.

evals.prompt: New Instagram DM has no phone number.
evals.expected_output: The skill allows lead creation using Instagram identity/username, leaves phone optional/unlocked and engages AI according to channel policy.
The skill validates/normalizes the explicit number (for India +919876543210 when context supports it) before mapping; it does not infer a number from username.

evals.prompt: Instagram inbox works but AI never replies.
evals.expected_output: The skill checks AI eligibility/runtime/outbound Send API separately from webhook/inbox health.

evals.prompt: Reconnect Instagram using an MCP tool that is not exposed.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports the capability/tool gap and uses the supported lifecycle/operational handoff instead of fabricating an action.
